notes.title: Update reccurent is reworked
notes.content:
[b]It all started with a tutorial from the profenix studio that allowed me to do a job like this: if the game has a discovery phase and musical exploration and sound effects, it won't be a standard FPS, but rather a tranquil and relaxing gameplay in an apocalyptic universe, the zombies in this game aren't aggressive, they live their lives in peace, looking around you and listening to every sound unique to this game (Warning= I had to delete the soldiers because they bugged every other time, so it's much easier to play a game without graphic glitches).[/b]

notes.title: Vythzkel of City coming soon
notes.content:
[u][b]Vythzkel of City is a new game which will be available on steam. It is currently being published and is due for release at the end of September.[/b][/u]

Vythzkel of city discover a game like no other a game where you can discover the facets of the scenery and the sound effects and all the work that I was able to accomplish alone, for me it was not easy several things we had to start again several times but I I ended up persevering myself, if you are interested in my work do not hesitate to share or clarify my work publicly.
